title: Index and Robustness of Mixed Equilibria: An Algebraic Approach
abstract: arXiv:2603.04298v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present two results regarding the relation of the index of equilibria and the index of fixed points, and the index of equilibria and payoff-robustness: any integer can be the index of an isolated completely mixed equilibrium of a finite game. In a particular class of isolated completely mixed equilibria, called monogenic, the index can be 0, +1 or -1 only. In this class non-zero index is equivalent to payoff-robustness. We also discuss extensions of the method of computation to extensive-form games, and cases where the equilibria might be located on the boundary of the strategy set. These results follow from a new method of computing indices of equilibria, which we also develop in this paper, that is based on algebraic properties of the system of polynomials describing completely mixed equilibria.

translated_title: 混合均衡的指数与稳健性：一种代数方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了关于均衡指数与不动点指数的关系，以及均衡指数与收益稳健性关系的两个结果：任何整数都可以作为有限博弈中一个孤立完全混合均衡的指数。在一类被称为“单基因”的特殊孤立完全混合均衡中，指数只能是0、+1或-1。在这一类均衡中，非零指数等价于收益稳健性。我们还讨论了将该方法扩展到扩展式博弈的计算方式，以及均衡可能位于策略集边界上的情形。这些结果源于一种新的均衡指数计算方法，该方法基于描述完全混合均衡的多项式系统的代数性质，我们也在本文中发展了这一方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于描述完全混合均衡的多项式系统代数性质的指数计算新方法，证明任何整数都可以作为有限博弈孤立完全混合均衡的指数，并在单基因均衡类中建立了非零指数与收益稳健性的等价关系。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a new algebraic method for computing equilibrium indices based on polynomial systems describing completely mixed equilibria, proving that any integer can be the index of an isolated completely mixed equilibrium of a finite game, and establishing that in the class of monogenic equilibria, non-zero index is equivalent to payoff-robustness.
